newsitem.title: UK: Bulmer shares firm as meets with analysts.
newsitem.headline: Bulmer shares firm as meets with analysts.

text.p: Shares in H.P. Bulmer Holdings firmed again on Wednesday as the cider-making firm met with industry analysts to update them on recent trading.
Bulmer, still suffering from the fallout from rival Matthew Clark's shock profit warning last month, is due to meet with a number of analysts later today, said market sources.
The shares added 17-1/2p in early trading to 532-1/2p.
Matthew Clark stunned investors in September with a warning that tough competition from new alcopop drinks had hit summer sales sending shares sliding over 50 percent and dragging Bulmer with it.
Bulmer said then it had held its own against alcopop competition and the shares have rallied in recent weeks off a closing price of 487-1/2p on September 26.
